evals.prompt: blur the sensitive data in test-screenshot.webp
evals.expected_output: Detects .env values, bearer token, and API response PII. Asks clarifying questions about what to blur (values vs whole lines, which JSON fields). After user confirms, runs ImageMagick with per-line regions. Verifies output.
expectations: Checks that ImageMagick is installed before proceeding
Runs magick identify to get image dimensions before generating coordinates
Presents findings grouped by type in plain language without pixel coordinates
Asks at least one clarifying question about what to blur
Uses per-line blur regions for structured content rather than one big rectangle
Reads the output image back to verify the blur worked

evals.prompt: I need to share this screenshot in our docs but hide the email addresses. Can you blur just the emails in test-screenshot.webp?
evals.expected_output: Locates the email in the API response. Mentions other sensitive content it found (API keys, bearer token, etc.) and asks if the user wants those blurred too. Blurs at minimum what was asked for.
expectations: Identifies the email address in the JSON response
Proactively mentions other sensitive content beyond what user asked about
Asks whether user wants the additional sensitive content blurred
Does not blur content the user didn't ask for without confirmation
Verifies the output image after blurring

evals.prompt: hey can you clean up test-screenshot.webp before i post it on github? theres some stuff in there that probably shouldnt be public
evals.expected_output: Understands the vague request as a blur/redact task. Scans image, presents all sensitive content found, asks targeted questions about what to include/exclude. Handles the casual tone appropriately.
expectations: Recognizes this as a blur/redact request despite vague phrasing
Scans and identifies sensitive content categories
Presents findings in a clear organized way
Asks what the user wants blurred rather than assuming everything
Does not show pixel coordinates or raw magick commands to the user
